channel.title: Bartek Kus
channel.description: Pragmatic full-stack engineer; identity; local-first infra; AI-assisted dev.

item.title: EnRaHiTu: the whole application in one container
item.description: Encore.ts for typed APIs, rauthy for identity, hiqlite for replicated SQLite, Turso's libSQL underneath: the template chassis Statecraft stamps, and why zero managed-infrastructure dependencies is the entire point.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)

item.title: From Open Agentic Platform to Statecraft
item.description: This week I archived my flagship and rebuilt it ground-up in days. What died, what survived, and why a spec corpus made killing a quarter-million governed lines the cheap option.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)

item.title: One binary, two faces: statecraft-cli
item.description: I retired a desktop app and replaced it with a Rust binary that is a CLI for humans and an MCP server for agents. The interesting part is why those had to be the same binary.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)

item.title: Rewriting under governance: notes from a four-day teardown
item.description: The rename essay tells you why the platform was rebuilt. This one is the mechanic's log: specs rewritten before code, authority transferred edge by edge, agents forbidden from bending the law to match their output, and the three boot defects the gates never promised to catch.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)

item.title: The factory is a service now
item.description: factory-encore promised a technology-agnostic software factory. Statecraft kept the factory and shot the framework: what changed when the contract moved from a technology-free document to a versioned template.toml with a gate behind it.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)

item.title: Yolo mode is earned: three layers of Claude Code settings
item.description: I run Claude Code with permission prompts off. That is safe only because of what sits underneath: a global deny floor, project hooks as reflexes, and a config that is itself governed.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)

item.title: Inside spec-spine: a typed authority ledger over markdown
item.description: The governance spine I lifted out of my platform and open-sourced: typed ownership edges, two deterministic registries, and a PR gate that refuses code drifting from its owning spec.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)

item.title: Production in the dev loop: Hetzner, Flux, and a read-only MCP
item.description: My Kubernetes cluster behaves like an extension of local development: the agent can see everything and touch nothing, and the only write path is git.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)

item.title: Agentic code collapse, and the substrate that prevents it
item.description: Agent-built codebases have a characteristic failure mode: each diff is locally plausible while the system slides into incoherence. Receipts from a quarter-million governed lines on why mine hasn't.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)

item.title: Reading OWASP's Agentic Top 10 against a real platform
item.description: I mapped the OWASP ASI 2026 entries onto open-agentic-platform, control by control. The exercise kept landing on the same small set of governance mechanisms, and that is the finding.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)

item.title: Architecting intent vs vibe coding
item.description: AI can write the code; the unsolved problem is trusting what it wrote. Why review doesn't scale, and how specs-as-law makes agentic output governable.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)

item.title: Probabilistic AI behind deterministic gates
item.description: LLMs are probabilistic by design; trustworthy systems are deterministic at the boundary. The architecture rule that makes agentic output admissible.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)

item.title: Local-first, now governed
item.description: The local-first thesis grew a governance layer: why the agentic execution plane belongs on your machine, with no SaaS in the trust path.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)

item.title: Identity in practice: OIDC, SSI, and DID without the hype
item.description: Practical guidance on when to use each identity standard, what to avoid, and links to authoritative specs.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)

item.title: Design principles for resilient systems
item.description: Exploring simplicity, observability, blast radius, idempotency, and graceful degradation in distributed systems.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)

item.title: RAG beyond the demo: failure modes and patterns
item.description: Exploring indexing strategies, chunking approaches, evaluation frameworks, observability, and guardrails for production RAG systems.
item.author: bartekus@gmail.com (Bartek Kus)
